item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,py_compile\\nfrom work import evaluate\\npy_compile.compile('work.py',doraise=True)\\nrequest={'claim':'boundary','conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None}}\\nevidence=[{'source':'verified-old','claim':'boundary','value':False,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':True},{'source':'unverified-new','claim':'boundary','value':True,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':None},'verified':False,'supersedes':['verified-old']},{'source':'wrong-type','claim':'boundary','value':True,'conditions':{'mode':'x','calibration':0},'verified':True}]\\npolicy={'required_conditions':['mode','calibration'],'require_verified':True}\\nbefore=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))\\nactual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)\\nexpected={'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['verified-old'],'unknowns':[]}\\nassert actual==expected,(actual,expected)\\nassert (request,evidence,policy)==before\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json') as f: current_evidence=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: current_policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report==[evaluate(r,current_evidence,current_policy) for r in requests]\\nprint(json.dumps({'boundary':actual,'report':report},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))\\n\"]}"}
